title: Footnote to the Surcharge Schedule: the Frequent-Traveller Concession, Vacation Package Products
content:
*Footnote.* The figure worked out for the party on a notified surcharge, on any of the Vacation Package Products, carries a loyalty rate, and a traveller's record with the Wanderlane Traveller Club may reduce it. The package accruals counted are those standing on that membership's points ledger which arose from a package booking, counted over the window named in each limb below and taken back from the handling date. The frequent-traveller threshold for this footnote is 3 package accruals in the last thirty-six months.

**Above the threshold.** Where the traveller's club points ledger carries more than the frequent-traveller threshold of package accruals in the last thirty-six months — that is, 4 or more — and the club membership stands active, the loyalty rate is the whole of it less the loyalty concession published for this calculation, which is 6 per cent.

**At the threshold.** Where the traveller's club points ledger carries exactly the frequent-traveller threshold of package accruals in the last thirty-six months — that is, exactly 3 — and the club membership stands active, the loyalty rate is the whole of it less the near-threshold concession published for this calculation, which is 3 per cent.

**Otherwise.** Where the count in that window is 2 or fewer, or the membership does not stand active, no concession under this footnote is taken.

| Package accruals in the last thirty-six months | Membership standing | Concession taken off the loyalty rate |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 4 or more | active | 6 per cent |
| exactly 3 | active | 3 per cent |
| 2 or fewer | active | none under this footnote |
| any count | not active | none under this footnote |

*Worked hypothetically.* A party figure of 200.00 USD, a membership standing active, and 5 package accruals in the last thirty-six months: the loyalty rate is 94 hundredths, and the figure carried forward is 188.00 USD. With exactly 3 such accruals the loyalty rate is 97 hundredths, and the figure carried forward is 194.00 USD.
